mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_log_profile (project_id, log_dir, main_log_file, rolling_pattern, timestamp_regex, timestamp_format, max_line_length, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{logDir}, #{mainLogFile}, #{rollingPattern}, #{timestampRegex}, #{timestampFormat}, #{maxLineLength}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{tenantId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_log_profile WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
